style_context: Citizenship and civic engagement in a community setting

images.description: A Scout standing in a vibrant town square looking at a community bulletin board covered in flyers and announcements, with a city hall building and a public library visible in the background on a clear day

Scouts of diverse backgrounds participating in a community town hall meeting, several seated in the audience and one standing at a microphone to speak, with council members visible at a raised dais in the background
Scouts in clean uniforms working alongside community members of various ages to plant young trees in a neighborhood park on a sunny day, with shovels and saplings visible
A Scout studying a large poster-sized diagram on a classroom wall showing the three pillars of citizenship labeled Rights, Duties, and Obligations, with bullet points under each pillar
A Scout in a clean uniform helping an elderly neighbor carry grocery bags up a front porch walkway on a residential sidewalk, both smiling warmly
A Scout sitting at a desk using a laptop showing a digital map application, with a printed community map spread out beside the laptop and an open notebook with handwritten notes

An illustrated bird's-eye view of a small American town showing labeled community landmarks including a city hall with a flag, a fire station with a red truck, a green park with playground equipment, a library building, and a hospital with a cross symbol

A clean, colorful organizational chart on a whiteboard showing the structure of a typical city government with the Mayor at the top, City Council beside them, and department heads like Police Chief, Fire Chief, and Public Works Director connected by lines below
A Scout at a library computer researching their local government website displayed on the monitor, with handwritten notes and a hand-drawn organizational chart on paper beside the keyboard

A Scout sitting attentively in the audience of a city council meeting chamber, taking notes in a small notebook, with council members seated at a raised curved dais in the background and an American flag on display
A Scout sitting in the gallery of a meeting hall with wooden benches, writing observations in a notebook with a focused and engaged expression, with other audience members visible nearby
A Scout reviewing a local newspaper spread out on a table and taking notes about a community issue in a notebook, with a window showing a city hall building in the background

A Scout in a clean uniform sitting across a desk from a friendly government official in a municipal office, the Scout holding a pen and notebook while the official gestures as they explain something, both appearing engaged in conversation

A Scout watching a movie on a television screen in a living room setting with a parent sitting nearby, a notebook and pen resting on the coffee table ready for note-taking, warm lamp lighting in the room

A large movie screen displaying a scene of diverse community members gathered together in a town square with buildings in the background, viewed from the perspective of someone in the audience with the edge of a theater seat visible

A four-panel split-scene illustration showing taxpayer-funded services in action: a fire truck with lights on responding to a call, a librarian helping a young patron find a book, a public bus at a stop with passengers boarding, and a park ranger maintaining a nature trail with tools

A Scout walking along a sidewalk through their town on a sunny day, passing a public library with its doors open, a fire station with a truck visible inside, and a public park with green trees, the Scout carrying a notebook and looking around with curiosity

A Scout in a clean uniform sorting canned goods and boxed food items at a community food bank alongside other volunteers of different ages, with organized shelves of donated food visible in the background

A group of Scouts wearing work clothes with clean uniforms visible underneath working alongside adult volunteers to paint a colorful mural on the exterior wall of a community center building on a bright day

A Scout standing confidently at the front of a room next to a large screen displaying a colorful slide presentation about their community, with a small audience of fellow Scouts and adults seated and watching attentively

A four-panel montage showing elements that might appear in a community presentation: a sepia-toned historic photograph of a main street, a vibrant cultural festival with decorations and food stalls, a beautiful public park with a lake and walking path, and a Scout speaking confidently to a seated audience
